capabilities: Generate AI reply cards on a Canvas
Branch conversations by re-running generation from earlier cards
Feed context to prompts via incoming arrows from cards or Markdown notes
Preview the exact context before sending a request
Connect through a saved AI Providers connection
extras: The 2.0.0 upgrade does not transfer the old endpoint, API key, or model selection, so connections must be reconfigured; the README warns that Generate AI note sends included Canvas text, linked Markdown, and PNG/JPEG images to the configured endpoint.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to run AI conversations or branch them across cards.

relations.evidence: Install and enable AI Providers 1.13.0 or newer in the same vault.

requires.name: API key or account for hosted providers

summary: Branching AI chat on Obsidian Canvas: selected cards get generated reply cards, and incoming arrows supply conversation context.
